summary_en: Annual dividend raised to ¥30/share (from ¥24/share) for FY2027 ending March 2027. Interim (Q2) dividend ¥15/share, year-end dividend ¥15/share, each increased from ¥12/share. Figures stated post-5:1 stock split effective 2026-09-01. Increase driven by upward earnings revision (full-year net profit forecast raised 43.8% to ¥9,200M) on AI datacenter-driven demand for optical connectors.
title_en: Notice on Revisions to Full-Year and Second Quarter Consolidated Earnings Forecasts for FY2027 (Ending March 2027) and Dividend Forecast Revision (Dividend Hike)
translation_en_brief: Seikoh Giken announced on 10 August 2026 a revision to its FY2027 (ending 31 March 2027) full-year and interim (H1, second quarter) earnings forecasts, along with an upward revision to its dividend forecast. The company raised its full-year net profit forecast 43.8% to ¥9,200 million from ¥6,400 million, driven by stronger-than-expected demand for optical connectors used in AI datacenters globally. In line with the improved earnings outlook, the company increased its annual dividend per share from ¥24 to ¥30 (post-5:1 split), with the interim dividend rising from ¥12 to ¥15 per share and the year-end dividend similarly raised from ¥12 to ¥15 per share. All dividend figures are stated on a post-split basis following the 5:1 stock split effective 1 September 2026. The dividend increase reflects management's priority on stable and continuous shareholder returns while retaining sufficient reserves for future investment. The revision was prompted by strong order intake across optical connectors, polishing equipment, and measurement devices, with production capacity expansion successfully executed to meet elevated customer capex demand in the datacenter buildout cycle.
